$comment: What every binding must produce, given the same inputs.
The steps are short enough to read as code in each language (see
bindings/csharp/test/InteropSmoke for the reference), but the values are not
a matter of taste: a binding that derives a different address from this
mnemonic has a broken crypto or encoding path, and one that reports a
different balance from this recorded reply has a broken transport.
docs/BINDINGS.md §5 lists the behaviours to check alongside these values.

derived.$comment: From the mnemonic above, on chain -3, with the V5R1 contract and default parameters.
